name: Mateo Velez
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing himself, but through a keen interest in the engineering aspects. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, initially intending to work in automotive manufacturing. However, a chance internship with a small Colombian racing team ignited his passion for the high-stakes world of motorsport strategy. He quickly realized that his analytical skills and calm demeanor under pressure were perfectly suited for guiding drivers and engineers to victory.

His approach to race strategy is deeply rooted in data analysis and risk assessment. Mateo is known for his ability to identify and exploit subtle advantages on the track, often making bold calls that defy conventional wisdom. His time at Ferrari AF Corse has seen him develop a reputation for meticulous planning and adaptability, ensuring the team remains competitive even in the face of unexpected challenges. He is distinctive for his focus on long-term gains rather than short-term glory, prioritizing consistent performance throughout the season.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: A man of average height with a lean build, Mateo carries himself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to listen to classical music to relax before a race.
